story.title: Why This Penguin Leaves Her Only Egg
story.start_state: a mother leaving her only egg for two months looks like abandonment

hook.line: An emperor penguin hands over her only egg, and leaves for about two months.

steps.label: one egg, handed over, and she leaves
steps.situation: The female transfers her single egg to the male and leaves for about two months.

steps.label: he cannot hunt with the egg
steps.situation: He cannot go hunting with the egg on his feet.

steps.label: the departure is the feeding run
steps.situation: She feeds at sea so that food reaches the chick: the parent holding the egg cannot fetch it.

steps.label: months without food
steps.situation: The male has not eaten for months by the time the egg hatches.

steps.label: if the chick hatches before she returns
steps.situation: If the chick hatches before she returns, he can briefly feed it a milk-like secretion from his oesophagus.

steps.label: she returns with food; he goes to eat
steps.situation: She returns with food and takes over the chick; the male goes to sea to eat, and for the chick's first weeks they take turns.

steps.label: she came back with dinner
steps.situation: She did not abandon the family; she came back with dinner.
